# Dataset Setup

Raw competition data files are **not included** in this repository due to size (each file is 100MB–8GB).

## Source

Download from the [Unstop competition portal](https://unstop.com/competitions/1743604/round/1593683/play/code):

- `student_resource/dataset/train.tsv` (~486 MB)
- `student_resource/dataset/test.tsv` (~121 MB)
- `student_resource/dataset/val.tsv`

## Placement

Place downloaded files in:

```
ML/
└── student_resource/
    └── dataset/
        ├── train.tsv
        ├── test.tsv
        └── val.tsv
```

## Generated Files (also excluded from git)

These are generated by the pipeline and are large:

| File | Size | Generated by |
|------|------|-------------|
| `go1_output/phase_2_cleaning/cleaned/clean_*.tsv` | 484–1,465 MB | Phase 2 cleaning |
| `go1_output/phase_3_blocking/candidates/candidate_pairs_*.tsv` | 5–8 GB | Phase 3 blocking |
| `go2_output/matching_results*.tsv` | 72–76 MB | Phase 4 inference |
| `team_submission*.zip` | ~2 GB | Packaging script |
